crashFund.reserveNote: Unused monthly Crash Fund carries over up to reserveCapMonths x the monthly Crash Fund; the excess overflows into the next month's Normal pool. Weekly release is a share of this month's Crash pool (monthly Crash Fund + carried reserve). Counting starts from the ledger's reserveStartMonth.

indexDrawdownLadder.note: Index drawdown ladder: Crash Fund goes to SPY/QQQ by each index's own 52-week drawdown. Market regime, volatility and drawdown labels never cancel index Base; data errors and manual panic still block.

stockBasePreservation.note: Individual-stock price and market-risk labels stop Extra and Crash but keep scheduled Base. Data errors, manual panic/pauses and a 52-week drawdown at or above maxDrawdownPct (value-trap guard) still cancel Base.
